reviews_captured_by_me.text: We were looking for someone to do a covered patio and came across Keith and team. They took our vision and brought it to life. What an A+ team. They are the best at what they do and communicate so great throughout the whole project and even have checked in on us a year later. We couldn’t have asked for a better team to do our patio! So glad we found them! If I could give more than 5 stars, I definitely would! Highly recommend Keith and his great team!

🙌🏻 Keith and his team brought our basement vision to life in a way that exceeded what we had imagined from the start. From the initial planning through the final walkthrough, the entire process felt organized, thoughtful, and collaborative.

A special shoutout to Julian and his crew— they were efficient, respectful of our home, and consistently left the space clean at the end of each day. They also made a point to keep us informed and involved throughout the build, which made a big difference in our confidence in the process.

We also worked with several of Keith’s hand-selected partners, and the quality of their craftsmanship truly elevated the finished space. The hardwood stairs and quartz countertops completely transformed the basement, and the custom cabinetry and bar shelving created exactly the moody-but-warm atmosphere we were hoping for.

Most importantly, we were looking for a team we could trust with a major home investment, and Keith and his team delivered on that. If you’re considering a basement remodel and want quality workmanship with a team that stands behind their work, we highly recommend Devlin Remodeling.

Keith and Liz and their team did a great job.  We had a Lean-2 and Pergola built. Their service was excellent, the best we have encountered. Their response to any questions and or concern's were handled right away. They kept us informed about the job at all times.  Keith is very upfront and lets you know what the cost were and if there were any changes. We appreciated the honesty and quality of their work.  We would recommend them to friends and family or anyone who asks…
We would not go to any other remodeling company. Devlin remodeling has our trust and loyalty and if we would need any more work done Keith would be our first call… they are a company who stands behind all of their work. That’s really hard to find today.
